title: Document Ownership
content: Document ownership is assigned from the authenticated user. The public document creation payload does not choose owner_id. Authorization uses ownership to decide which documents and chunks the authenticated user may access.

title: Database Migrations
content: The Mission Knowledge Assistant uses Alembic to version and apply PostgreSQL schema migrations. The migration history is kept in source control so database structure changes can be reproduced.

title: RAG Answerability and Abstention
content: Retrieval success does not automatically mean a question is answerable. If authorized evidence is absent or semantic evaluation does not permit generation, the RAG pipeline abstains instead of generating an unsupported answer.

title: JWT Authentication
content: After login, the API issues a JWT containing the user identifier in the sub claim and includes iat and exp claims. Protected routes require a Bearer token. Missing or invalid authentication is rejected with HTTP 401 and the generic detail Could not validate credentials.

title: Password Security
content: User passwords are never persisted as plaintext. The password service hashes passwords with Argon2 before storage and verifies login passwords against the stored hash.

title: Hybrid Retrieval
content: Hybrid retrieval combines textual and semantic rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Ownership filtering is applied before ranking and before top_k so another user's chunks cannot consume authorized ranking slots.

title: Semantic Retrieval
content: Semantic retrieval generates an embedding for the query and ranks authorized chunks by cosine distance. An optional max_distance removes candidates whose semantic distance exceeds the configured threshold.

title: Document Chunking
content: The chunker strips surrounding whitespace and splits document text into fixed-size character chunks. The current defaults are chunk_size 500 and overlap 50. The chunker itself does not persist data.

title: RAG Context Builder
content: The Context Builder receives authorized retrieval results, preserves their order, formats them into RAG context, and retains evidence provenance. It currently has no token budget, sophisticated truncation, or sophisticated deduplication.

title: Provider Failure Handling
content: Known operational provider failures use ProviderUnavailableError and are translated at the HTTP boundary to 503 Service Unavailable with a generic public message. Provider failure is distinct from normal RAG abstention, and unexpected bugs are not masked by broad exception handling.

title: Generation Gate
content: The generator boundary is provider-agnostic. Generation is allowed only when the answerability decision has can_generate set to true. Otherwise the pipeline does not invoke generation and follows the abstention path.

title: Sources and Provenance
content: RAG sources represent provenance of the context supplied to the pipeline. A source being returned does not prove that every generated claim was causally derived from that source. Claim-level validation is not implemented.

title: Software Tests and Quality Evaluation
content: Pytest checks software contracts and regressions. The evaluation harness measures behavior over a fixed versioned corpus and cases. Controlled harness tests are kept separate from explicit quality evaluation runs that use real embeddings and retrieval.
